protocol.purpose: Audit entry opportunity and compare simple exits with SAME five-minute first decision, hard ladder, costs, fills and guards as frozen PPO. No training, new signal or filter selection.
protocol.observation: Passive path with original stop/global/daily/liquidation guards. Only known one-minute closes while still open; no exit-candle high/low or close after intrabar closure. Positive/10/20/40% net ROI close observations are retrospective opportunities, never actual executable profits. At decision cadence count only five-minute timestamps before data end. Actual ladder executions are reported separately.
protocol.reference: Frozen original quantity/margin and entry snapshot; hypothetical liquidation includes modeled exit fee/adverse slippage/ticks and funding already known. Flat-price round-trip friction includes both entry and exit execution and fees, before funding.
protocol.groupUse: Descriptive only. All feature groups known before entry; no group becomes a filter, selected winner or new model. Flag samples below20.
protocol.sample: All320sourcepositions, with train189/dev131 shown separately;59uncontrollable positions retained. No reusing test2025 orSeptember2026.
protocol.simpleExits: Every rule starts at the same first5minute decision as PPO and keeps the same automatic25/50/25ladder and initial remaining-cost protection. close_first requests a full close at every first permitted decision (ladder priority preserved); ladder_wait waits; ladder_lock chooses net0.25R lock whenever eligible; ladder_trail chooses1ATR after1R. Stop and guards remain active from entry. No holding-time limit added.
protocol.wallets: Same archived source signals; own monthly R$1000wallet/risk1%, sizes reflect own cash, report overlap/risk skips. CDI only on real monthly wallets. Paired positions may overlap and their sum is not portfolio wealth.
protocol.comparison: All six FINAL65536stepPPOpolicies archived before this audit; compare each seed and aggregate all three per arm. No new model inference or checkpoint choice. Per-position PPO uses131development IDs; wallet comparison same five months.
protocol.limitations: Retrospective post-pilot diagnostic on already consumed calendars; G91 source itself was trained/selected with these histories. Not independent validation, statistical proof or deployable standalone entry strategy. No optimization or promotion from these results.
